monthly_jump.title: Unusual change in monthly tax receipts
monthly_jump.text: Receipts in this month differ from the same month a year earlier far more than that tax's normal year-on-year movement. Timing (payment dates falling either side of a month end), tax rises or one-offs are common innocent causes.

taxgap_revision.title: Tax gap estimate later revised
taxgap_revision.text: HMRC's later estimate of a past year's tax gap differs materially from its earlier estimate.
